boxes.title: Plasma Charger
boxes.alt: Drawing of a Cyborg Plasma Charger.
boxes.description: Weapons like this Plasma Charger are more powerful than standard Fusion weapons. The main armament of Cyborg Agitators.

boxes.title: Plasma Charger Overcharge
boxes.alt: Drawing of a Cyborg overcharged Plasma Charger and a sign of a black skull.
boxes.description: By charging the weapon beyond safe limits, the Plasma Charger is capable of firing more powerful blasts that create a small explosive force upon impact, allowing it to punch through vehicles with relative ease.

boxes.title: HE Grenade
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton HE Grenade and a sign of a explosion.
boxes.description: A throwable explosive similar to, but larger than, the [[G-12 High Explosive]] Grenade. Has a notably long fuse time that allows it to be quickly thrown back.

boxes.title: Augmented Fist
boxes.alt: Drawing of a Cyborg Augmented Fist.
boxes.description: Granted by their extensive augments, Cyborg Agitators have strength far beyond ordinary humans. Said units leverage their artifical vigor into inflicting grevious injuries onto human-sized adverseries, leaving them sprawled out on the ground in a daze.

boxes.title: Techno-Martial Arts
boxes.alt: Drawing of a Cyborg foot and a sign of a person doing a high kick.
boxes.description: Much like the zealous Radical, the Agitator is more than happy to engage in ultraviolent technology-powered martial arts against their hated foes. The end result for the foe is swift and highly lethal, often left as nothing more than a bloodied mess.

boxes.title: Scything Claws
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: Hyperevolved as a result of the Gloom, the Alpha Commander's claws are jagged and lethal. Oftentimes its former victims are nothing more than bloody chunks, and limbs -- and even armoured vehicles -- are torn apart or punctured.

boxes.title: Primal Rush
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: Much like a bull, the Alpha Commander is capable of aggressively charging the foe. Those unlucky enough to not get out of its way will find themselves knocked down and brutally trampled underfoot.

boxes.title: Slashing Claws
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: Further evolved than the standard Warrior, the Alpha Warrior uses its claws with the same ferocity, reducing human targets to bloody chunks and leaving vehicles wrecked with dozens of puncture marks in seconds.

boxes.title: Fusion Battle Cannon
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Fusion Battle Cannon.
boxes.description: One of the largest standard Fusion weapons in the Automaton arsenal. The Battle Cannon's explosive shots are such that entire squads of infantry may be annihilated and armoured vehicles are left crippled. Mounted on Annihilator-class Heavy Tanks.

boxes.title: Co-Axial Fusion Cycler
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Co-Axial Fusion Cycler.
boxes.description: Annihilator-class Tanks also have a co-axial weapon in the form of the Fusion Cycler. This modified Fusion Repeater is capable of firing even faster, perfect for either suppressing or cutting down infantry.

boxes.title: Hull-Mounted Heavy Fusion Repeater
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Hull-Mounted Heavy Fusion Repeater.
boxes.description: This Heavy Fusion Repeater benefits being connected to the Tanks powerplant to output a far longer burst of sustained fire. Its limited traverse mount limits its flexibility in combat.

boxes.title: Ammunition Cookoff
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton tank with flaming holes and an explosion with a black skull inside it.
boxes.description: Between its massive powerplant and volatile fusion battery load it uses to power its weapons, the Annihilator Heavy Tank is particularly volatile when finally knocked out. This culminates into a catastrophic explosion.

boxes.title: Quad Heavy Fusion Cyclers (AA)
boxes.alt: A drawing of the Anti-Air Emplacement
boxes.description: With highly sophisticated aircraft tracking and targeting equipment mounted within, these turrets are mainstay Automaton weapons for AA Duties. Few airborne enemies survive long once they are locked in by an Emplacement Battery.

boxes.title: Fusion Pistol
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Fusion Pistol.
boxes.description: Its overall lighter weight and smaller size makes the Fusion Pistol popular with Jet Brigade units. Wielding it alongside a Heat Blade, the Assault Raider becomes a truly effective strike or shock unit that excels at close-quarters combat.

boxes.title: Heat Blades
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Heat Blade.
boxes.description: The Heat Blade's sheer damage makes the Heat Blade a mainstay for the Jet Brigade, who can take advantage of their Jump Packs to close the gap.

boxes.title: HE Grenade
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton HE Grenade and a sign of a explosion.
boxes.description: A throwable explosive similar to, but larger than, the [[G-12 High Explosive]] Grenade. Has a notably long fuse time that allows it to be quickly thrown back.

boxes.title: Jump Pack Detonation
boxes.alt: Drawing of an explosion with a black skull inside it.
boxes.description: The Jumppacks worn by those of the Jet Brigade are notably volatile when damaged or punctured, culminating into a fiery explosion.

boxes.title: Heavy MLRS (HE)
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Heavy MLRS (HE) and 4 rockets.
boxes.description: A massive, 33-barrelled launcher array. The Barrager Tank is loaded with large Ballistic Rockets, each one capable of atomizing an unsuspecting Helldiver, or sending those that survive indirect hits cartwheeling by violent, concussive blasts.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Vehicle|Anti-Vehicle|notext}}
(Ballistic Damage Only)
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])

boxes.title: MLRS Housing Explosion
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton tank with flaming holes, parts flying off of it and an explosion with a black skull inside it.
boxes.description: Given the sheer power of the Barrager Tank's rockets, it is perhaps no surprise that, should one of these warheads detonate prematurely, the resulting explosion will be a sight to behold.

boxes.title: Meatsaws
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Meatsaw.
boxes.description: The ubiquitous weapon of the equally brutal Berserker unit. The Meatsaw befits its user by bringing weight of intimidation with obvious effectiveness, alongside promises of pain before death.

boxes.title: Stomp
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton foot.
boxes.description: On account of their weight, most Devastator-sized units can simply crush structures, flora, and foes alike underfoot.

boxes.title: Caustic Surge
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: Acting on a scale far above Caustic Spewers, the Bile Titan is capable of regurgitating many gallons of caustic byproducts upon the foe that melt through nearly any material in a matter of seconds and reduce its unfortunate victims to steaming piles of goo.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Acid}}
(Impact + Blast Damage)
(1.5x Damage to [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits]])
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])
3/s Acid DPS (4.0s)
(Via Impact/Blast Damage)

boxes.title: Cataclysmic Slam
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Steel Fist.
boxes.description: Should dousing foes in gallons of caustic fluids somehow fail, the Bile Titan is also simply capable of crushing whatever is left with its multi-ton "pikes", impaling and skewering exos, cars and even tanks and outright obliterating anything smaller.

boxes.title: Heat Blades
boxes.alt: Drawing of a Heat Blade.
boxes.description: As a red-hot melee weapon, the Heat Blade is capable of inflicting grievous damage to both armour and flesh alike. The favoured weapon of Brawlers.

boxes.title: HE Grenade
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton HE Grenade and a sign of a explosion.
boxes.description: A throwable explosive similar to, but larger than, the [[G-12 High Explosive]] Grenade. Has a notably long fuse time that allows it to be quickly thrown back.

boxes.title: Impaling Claws
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: Like the standard Warrior-strains, the claws of the Brood Commander are a force to be reckoned with, capable of effortlessly bifurcating human targets and cleanly tearing off sizable chunks of armoured vehicles like mere paper.

boxes.title: Bull Rush
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: Much like a bull, the Brood Commander is capable of aggressively charging its foe. Those unlucky enough to not get out of its way will find themselves knocked down and brutally trampled underfoot.

boxes.title: Fusion Falconet
boxes.alt: Drawing of the Command Bunker Turret's cannon.
boxes.description: Often found in fortified positions. Fusion Falconets are a relatively uncommon anti-vehicle weapon, capable of penetrating medium armour or laying down explosive fire with ease. Albeit its slow refire rate makes it seldom seen outside of Fortresses

boxes.title: Heavy Ram
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: Living up to its name, the Charger can simply use its immense, multi-ton mass to knock down, trample and crush foes, often doing so with such force that not even vehicles are safe from its wrath, being staggered or knocked aside as it rampages through.

boxes.title: Heavy Crush
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: Alteratively, the Charger may instead leverage its mass to simply crush whatever being (or thing) happens to be in front of it, leaving humans as nothing more than crumpled heaps and vehicles akin to crushed drink cans as it bears its entire weight.

boxes.title: Spore Eruption
boxes.description: Its body festooned with pressurized, fruiting spores, the death of a Caustic Charger can trigger a secondary reaction to the spores, which all spontaneously release at once, resulting in a massive eruption of mildly corrosive spores around the area.

boxes.title: Corrosive Regurgitation
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: A consequence of prolonged exposure to toxic chemicals, the Caustic Spewer violently purges highly volatile and corrosive substances upon the foe, rapidly reducing flesh and bone to vile-smelling sludge and vehicles to molten, smoke-belching wrecks.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Acid}}
(1.5x Damage to [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits]])
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])
3/s Acid DPS (4.0s)
(Via Direct Damage)

boxes.title: Bile Bombard
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: Rather unpleasantly, Caustic Spewers have evolved the muscles on their thorax structure to facilitate the launching of highly-concentrated "Bile Bombs" with great force and speed, allowing Caustic Spewers to act as primitive artillery.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Acid}}
(1.5x Damage to [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits]])
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])
3/s Acid DPS (4.0s)
(Via Blast Damage)

boxes.title: Heavy Swing
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Steel Fist.
boxes.description: Spewer-strains can also rely on their enlarged forelegs to swing and slam would-be-attackers. While not their most devastating attack, they are still more than capable of crushing bone and tearing flesh with each blow.

boxes.title: Pressurised Rupture
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: Much like their cousins, the fluids within the Caustic Spewer's rump are highly volatile. When finally punctured, the Spewer will explode violently, showering foes with extremely corrosive bile that reduces them to goo puddles in seconds.

boxes.title: Acidic Spit
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: The result of Terminid exposure to toxic chemicals. The mouth of the Caustic Spitter has mutated to an almost crossbow-like mechanism, allowing them to fire highly corrosive globules at any unfortunate foes in its way, melting holes in even steel armor.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Acid}}
(1.5x Damage to [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits]])
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])
3/s Acid DPS (4.0s)
(Via Blast Damage)

boxes.title: Acidic Rupture
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: Their entire stomach dedicated to the production of baleful bile, it is perhaps not shocking that Caustic Spitters are effectively dog-sized water balloons ready to violently burst at the slightest puncture, showering anything nearby with highly corrosive bile.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Acid}}
(1.5x Damage to [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits]])
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])
3/s Acid DPS (4.0s)
(Via Blast Damage)

boxes.title: Slashing Claws
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: The Warrior's chitin-hardened claws are more than capable of cleaving human-sized targets in half with but a few strikes. Even light vehicles, exosuits and buildings are not safe from its puncturing power.

boxes.title: Bile Rupture
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton White Phosphorus Grenade and a sign of flames.
boxes.description: Akin to the smaller Spitter, the Caustic Warrior is blighted with countless pustules filled to the brim with bile runoff which, when punctured, often burst violently, spraying corrosive fluids across the surrounding area capable of melting even vehicle armour.

boxes.title: Heavy Ram
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: Living up to its name, the Charger can simply use its immense, multi-ton mass to knock down, trample and crush foes, often doing so with such force that not even vehicles are safe from its wrath, being staggered or knocked aside as it rampages through.

boxes.title: Heavy Crush
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: Alteratively, the Charger may instead leverage its mass to simply crush whatever being (or thing) happens to be in front of it, leaving humans as nothing more than crumpled heaps and vehicles akin to crushed drink cans as it bears its entire weight.

boxes.title: Superheavy Crush
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: Befitting their aggression, the Behemoth is capable of cutting open even heavily armoured vehicles with their scythe-like forelegs, such is their weight and strength. Anything lesser than a tank will often be reduced to an unrecognisable mass.

boxes.title: Superheavy Ram
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: Ultilising their prow-shaped head, the Behemoth Charger is equally capable of doing serious damage by simply ramming whatever is in front of it, knocking down, trampling or swatting aside humans and exosuits alike like mere toys.

boxes.title: Fusion Pistol
boxes.alt: Drawing of a Commissar Fusion Pistol.
boxes.description: A one-handed version of the larger Automaton SMG. The Fusion pistol is lighter yet loses none of the stopping power compared to its larger cousin. Commissar units exclusively wield this handgun alongside a Heat Blade.

boxes.title: Heat Blades
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Heat Blade.
boxes.description: Commissar units are found wielding these red-hot melee weapons alongside their Fusion Pistol in battle.

boxes.title: HE Grenade
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton HE Grenade and a sign of a explosion.
boxes.description: A throwable explosive similar to, but larger than, the [[G-12 High Explosive]] Grenade. Has a notably long fuse time that allows it to be quickly thrown back.

boxes.title: Conflagration Scattergun
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Coflagration Scattergun and a sign of flames with three shotgun shells behind it.
boxes.description: The Conflagration Scattergun fires specialised incendiary shells rather than fusion bolts that saturate the target area in self-igniting pellets, inflicting grievous wounds alongside devastating burns.

boxes.title: Reinforced Steel Fist
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Reinforced Steel Fist.
boxes.description: Devastator units are known to punch their foes. They often hit with enough force to crack helmets or even fully knock down Helldivers.

boxes.title: Stomp
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton foot.
boxes.description: On account of their weight, most Devastator-sized units can simply crush structures, flora, and foes alike underfoot, clearing paths for lighter units to cross unimpeded.

boxes.title: Plasma Bombard (Direct Fire)
boxes.alt: A drawing of an Crescent Overseer's weapon with a symbol of a plasma projectile.
boxes.description: The heaviest portable weapon in the Overseer's arsenal. The Plasma Bombard is capable of discharging violent bolts of superheated plasma that are capable of reducing armoured infantry to nothing more than molten slag and vapourised flesh.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Vehicle|Anti-Vehicle|notext}}
(Ballistic Damage Only)
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])

boxes.title: Plasma Bombard (Indirect Fire)
boxes.alt: A drawing of an Crescent Overseer's weapon with a symbol of a plasma explosion.
boxes.description: Crescent Overseers can additionally turn their Plasma Bombards into terrifying artillery pieces. Here, they loose rapid salvoes of plasma bolts that are akin to a hail of flame, exploding in superheated fury upon impact.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Vehicle|Anti-Vehicle|notext}}
(Ballistic Damage Only)
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])

boxes.title: Armoured Fist
boxes.alt: A drawing of the Overseer's fist.
boxes.description: The Crescent Overseer can also land a fearsome punch upon any Helldiver that draws too close, often with enough force to crack their helmets outright with devastating results.

boxes.title: Heavy Cudgel
boxes.alt: A drawing of a Fleshmob appendage.
boxes.description: Swinging with the force of an artillery shell and with the ferocity only a Crusher could provide. The massive Cudgel is capable of reducing any human-sized foe into a mashed paste, as well as crushing even lightly armoured vehicles to pieces completely

boxes.title: Ground Quake
boxes.alt: A drawing of a fleshmob charging.
boxes.description: Alongside their mighty cudgels, the mutated Crusher is also simply capable of stomping surviving foes beneath its massive "feet", often landing with such tremendous force that they create disorienting shockwaves around them.

boxes.title: Fusion Assault Cannon
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Fusion Assault Cannon.
boxes.description: The staple of the Devastator unit's arsenal. This twin-barrelled Fusion weapon fires in steady 2-round bursts with significant stopping power, though its overall accuracy leaves something to be desired.

boxes.title: Reinforced Steel Fist
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Reinforced Steel Fist.
boxes.description: Devastator units are known to punch their foes. They often hit with enough force to crack helmets or even fully knock down Helldivers.

boxes.title: Stomp
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton foot.
boxes.description: On account of their weight, most Devastator-sized units can simply crush structures, flora, and foes alike underfoot, clearing paths for lighter units to cross unimpeded.

boxes.title: Alchemical Pyrosis
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: Somehow evolving to spray flammable venom instead of caustic filth. The Dragon Roach's firey breath is capable of spreading far and wide as it hovers, saturating the ground in chemical flame and immolating anything within it.

boxes.title: Plasma Storm Rifle
boxes.alt: A drawing of an Overseer rifle.
boxes.description: Utlilising advanced Illuminate technology, the Plasma Storm Rifle rapidly unloads salvos of glowing, baseball-sized plasma projectiles. Exclusively wielded by Elevated Overseers to lend fire support.

boxes.title: Plasma Detonator
boxes.alt: A drawing of an Overseer grenade.
boxes.description: Used by Elevated Overseers, these containers are built with a time fuse that, when expired, will unleash a blast of heat and light that bursts forth with plasma, burning any target caught in the blast.

boxes.title: Jetpack Rupture
boxes.alt: A deadly explosion symbol.
boxes.description: Despite their advanced technology, the Elevated Overseer's Jetpack explodes all the same when sufficiently punctured, oftentimes outright killing the user and anyone nearby in the process.

boxes.title: Fusion Repeater Cannon
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Fusion Repeater Cannon.
boxes.description: A heavily-modified Battle Cannon. The Fusion Repeater Cannon takes advantage of massive generators upon the Factory Strider to cycle up to three devastating shots in a single salvo. Only the hardiest of fortifications can hope to withstand such firepower.

boxes.title: Fusion Gatling Guns
boxes.alt: Drawning of an Automaton Fusion Gatling Gun.
boxes.description: Whilst lacking the stopping power or accuracy of the larger Heavy Fusion Repeater, the Fusion Gatling Gun makes up for this through sheer volume of fire, proving especially effective against lightly armored infantry and providing suppressive fire.

boxes.title: Cataclysmic Explosion
boxes.alt: Drawing of a flaming Automaton Factory Strider with flaming holes and an explosion with a black skull inside it.
boxes.description: The fusion generators powering the Factory Strider dwarf even the Automaton Heavy Tanks, supplying the demands of its many systems. The meltdown of its reactor is nothing less than cataclysmic.

boxes.title: Swing and Bludgeon
boxes.alt: A drawing of a Fleshmob appendage.
boxes.description: All Fleshmobs generally have massive appendages one can call "arms". It uses them to bludgeon, rip or crush beyond recognition any living being that it happens to see.

boxes.title: Rampage
boxes.alt: A drawing of a fleshmob charging.
boxes.description: Fleshmobs, seething mounds of bone and blubber, will often charge at the nearest foe, using their immense weight to trample infantry to paste and smash aside vehicles as if they were toys.

boxes.title: Plasma Starcannon (Charge)
boxes.alt: A Gatekeeper cannon with a symbol of a plasma projectile.
boxes.description: A step up compared to handheld Illuminate Weaponry. The Plasma Starcannon by default fires singular, charged up plasma bolts that shine like stars, puncturing all but the heaviest armour with haunting accuracy due to its use of sophisticated targeters.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Vehicle|Anti-Vehicle|notext}}
(Ballistic Damage Only)
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])

boxes.title: Plasma Starcannon (Volley)
boxes.alt: A drawing of an opened Gatekeeper cannon with stacked symbols of plasma projectiles.
boxes.description: The Starcannons can instead be set to fire a rapid-fire volley of plasma bolts down range. While such bolts do less damage overall, their sheer rate of fire is enough to devastate entire squads of infantry.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Vehicle|Anti-Vehicle|notext}}
(Ballistic Damage Only)
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])

boxes.title: Plasma Starcannon (Bludgeon)
boxes.alt: A drawing of a descending Gatekeeper cannon with a fist symbol.
boxes.description: The pilot within the Gatekeeper may occasionally use the Gatekeeper's Starcannons as primitive clubs which, while clearly not their intended role, are still effective in swatting away foes that draw too close.

boxes.title: Heavy Fusion Cycler
boxes.alt: Drawing of a mounted Automaton Heavy Fusion Cycler.
boxes.description: A Heavy Fusion Repeater modified to sustain a much longer salvo. The Heavy Fusion Cycler allows the Gunship to lay down a withering hail of fire. Accompanied by improved targeting packages to compensate for firing on the move.

boxes.title: HEAT Rocket Racks
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton HEAT Rocket Rack and 3 rockets.
boxes.description: Augmenting the Gunships arsenal are 2 Rocket Racks loaded with standard HEAT munitions. Such dual-purpose munitions are primarily an anti-infantry weapon, blasting apart entire squads, but they are also effective at cracking open vehicles.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Vehicle|Anti-Vehicle|notext}}
(Ballistic Damage Only)
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])

boxes.title: Crash and Burn (Fuselage)
boxes.alt: Drawing of an burning Automaton Gunship and aa explosion with a black skull inside it.
boxes.description: Being multiple tons of steel, ammunition and fuel, even a plummeting Gunship is equally dangerous to its targets as if it was still airborne, slamming the ground with great force and burying those too slow to escape the burning wreckage.

boxes.title: Crash and Burn (Engines)
boxes.alt: Drawing of an burning Automaton Gunship and aa explosion with a black skull inside it.
boxes.description: Downed gunships additionally crash onto terra firma with such force they break into multiple parts. In particular, the Engine Pods break off with considerable force, crushing or slamming into any unfortunate being in the way.

boxes.title: Fuel Explosion
boxes.alt: Drawing of an explosion with a black skull inside it.
boxes.description: Even still-burning, crashed Gunships are a ticking time bomb before said flames ignite either unburned fuel or undetonated ammunition loads. Such explosions are both devastating to those nearby and supposedly spectacular who (safely) witness it.

boxes.title: Disintegration Beamer (Standard)
boxes.alt: A drawing of a Harvester face in side profile with a symbol of a plasma laser.
boxes.description: Feared greatly, the Disintegration Beamer is a devastating weapon that fires a rippling beam of blinding blue light from its eye, vaporizing infantry and tanks alike, leaving only charred and torn-up terrain in its wake.

boxes.title: Disintegration Beamer (Damaged)
boxes.alt: A drawing of a Harvester face in side profile with a symbol of a plasma laser with an explosion on the end.
boxes.description: The Disintegration Beamer is connected to the eye of the Harvester, which, when shattered, amplifies the beam it fires as it becomes unstable, which serves to highlight the sheer danger this living engine presents.

boxes.title: Tesla Ripper
boxes.alt: A drawing of a Harvester face in side profile with an electric symbol.
boxes.description: The Tesla Ripper fires an arc of searing electricity from the Harvester's eye which rips apart its targets upon impact.

boxes.title: Fusion Repeater
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Fusion Repeater.
boxes.description: Coupled with its bulky Power Generator, The Fusion Repeater is the mainstay weapon within Heavy Devastator arsenals. It is capable of achieving a tremendous sustained rate of fire, easily able to cut down infantry with terrifying efficiency.

boxes.title: Reinforced Steel Fist
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Reinforced Steel Fist.
boxes.description: Devastator-sized units are known to punch their foes. They often hit with enough force to crack helmets or even fully knock down Helldivers.

boxes.title: Stomp
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton foot.
boxes.description: On account of their weight, most Devastator-sized units can simply crush structures, flora, and foes alike underfoot, clearing paths for lighter units to cross unimpeded.

boxes.title: Heavy Claw
boxes.alt: Hive Guard claw.

boxes.alt: Hunter Claw.
boxes.description: Larger and far more refined than those of the Pouncer, the Hunter's mantis-like arms are more akin to talons, slashing through armour like paper whilst its serrated edge leaves gaping wounds and shattered bones upon the hapless victim.

boxes.title: Leap
boxes.alt: Hunter Pounce
boxes.description: Much like the Pouncer, the Hunter uses its highly developed legs to leap great distances and to ambush unsuspecting targets. Such attacks are quick and violent, using its mass to drive its oversized talons into the victim.

boxes.title: Acidic Lash
boxes.alt: Hunter Tongue
boxes.description: Hunters have developed long, weaponized tongues. Said tongues are coiled within their mouth with great tension and additionally laced with corrosive toxins. These tongues then spring out like a whip and lash the target with envenomed burns.

boxes.title: Tentacle Slam
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: Striking with the force of an artillery shell at times, the Impaler's chitin-hardened Tentacles are more than capable of tearing a human target into mere chunks and puncturing even tanks with immense force, all with unerring accuracy.

boxes.title: Momentous Slam
boxes.description: While prefering to strike from afar with its specifically evolved tentacles. Impalers are not unaware of their immense size and strength, which they will happily (and quite clumsily) leverage should the foe get too close to comfort.

boxes.title: Fusion Conflagrator
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Fusion Conflagrator and a sign of flames.
boxes.description: A Fusion Repeater modified by the Incineration Corps. The Fusion Conflagrator fires projectiles that can ignite any target they hit. This is offset by a massive drop in firerate and fire time.

boxes.title: Reinforced Steel Fist
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Reinforced Steel Fist.
boxes.description: Devastator units are known to punch their foes. They often hit with enough force to crack helmets or even fully knock down Helldivers.

boxes.title: Stomp
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton foot.
boxes.description: On account of their weight, most Devastator-sized units can simply crush structures, flora, and foes alike underfoot, clearing paths for lighter units to cross unimpeded.

boxes.title: Portable Fusion Cannon
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Fusion Cannon and a laser with a small explosion at the end.
boxes.description: This Portable Cannon grants Troopers the ability to blast away cover, infantry, and can even penetrate armored vehicles. Currently exclusively used by Trooper units within the Incineration Corps.

boxes.title: Steel Fist
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Trooper fist.
boxes.description: Often reserved for the foe who strays too close for comfort. A solid blow from a Trooper's steel-plated fist is more than capable of cracking plate, rupturing organs, and completely shattering bone with ease.

boxes.title: White Phosphorus Grenade
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton White Phosphorus Grenade and a sign of flames.
boxes.description: A heavily modified HE Grenade. This grenade replaces its explosive charge for a bursting charge that sprays out White Phosphorus in the general area, igniting almost instantly as it contacts air and showering the area with bright hot flame.

boxes.title: Plasma Torch
boxes.alt: A drawing of an Obtruder eye with a symbol of a plasma projectile.
boxes.description: Fitted onto the ever numerous Obtruder. The Plasma Torch is an unremarkable weapon, yet very effective when fired en masse by multiple Obtruders, capable of reducing any human-sized foe into a burnt-out heap of flesh and bone.

boxes.title: Crashing Weight
boxes.alt: A deadly explosion symbol.
boxes.description: Much like its Watcher relative, a knocked out Obtruder can still be a hazard to any underneath it. Its weight is capable of crushing any unfortunate that happens to be below it.

boxes.title: Detonation
boxes.alt: A deadly explosion symbol.
boxes.description: The Obtruder has an alarming tendency to violently explode upon crashing onto solid ground, killing infantry and even capable of severely damaging vehicles.

boxes.title: Pathfinder Lightspear (Projectile)
boxes.alt: A drawing of an Overseer staff with a symbol of a plasma projectile.
boxes.description: An arcane weapon emulating the staffs used by Apprentices of old, the Pathfinder Lightspear is a devastating combination weapon, firing plasma bolts that are capable of burning fist-sized holes through armoured infantry and even light vehicle armour.

boxes.alt: A drawing of an Overseer staff with a symbol of a hammer.
boxes.description: Overseers will alternatively use their Lightspears in melee combat, swinging and spinning the staffs with immense strength and grace, able to quickly knock Helldivers onto the ground.

boxes.title: Serrated Claws
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Steel Fist.
boxes.description: Formed from chitin with distinctive serrations, the Pouncer is more than capable of leaving messy, gaping wounds even with its diminutive size, especially after its trademark "pounce".

boxes.title: Rending Slash
boxes.alt: Hunter Claw.
boxes.description: Much like standard Hunter-strains, the Predator Strain Hunter is equipped with 2 mantis-like arms festooned with razor-sharp spines capable of eviscerating armour and leaving messy, gaping wounds with each slash.

boxes.title: Predatory Leap
boxes.alt: Hunter Pounce
boxes.description: Augmented with cloaking abilities, the Predator Hunter is capable of hiding in plain sight, waiting for the right moment to strike. When it finally pounces, it does so with the same ferocity and speed as its non-mutated counterparts.

boxes.title: Acidic Lash
boxes.alt: Hunter Tongue
boxes.description: Much like their unmutated cousins, the Predator Hunter is equipped with a flexible and strong tongue laced with highly corrosive toxins that springs out like a whip, lashing skin with the painful toxins and slowing movement.

boxes.title: Corrosive Reflux
boxes.alt: Hunter Tongue
boxes.description: Unique to the Predator-strain variant of the Hunter, alongside their venomous tongue, is the presence of sacs capable of regurgitating Bile akin to the large Caustic Spewer, showering the victim and their wounds with highly corrosive acid capable of melting bone and steel.

boxes.title: Impaling Strike
boxes.alt: Stalker Claws
boxes.description: Hyper-specialised in stalking and viciously dispatching prey. The Stalker's unique, mantis-like talons are capable of striking with blistering speed, sometimes even bifurcating human targets.

boxes.title: Portable Flamer
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: Perhaps emulating Cyborg Immolator units of the GW1. This Flamer is the signature weapon of the Pyrotroopers, valued for their ability to destroy both enemies and buildings with a burst of expanding flame, being especially effective against colonies.

boxes.title: Cyborg Smoke Grenade
boxes.alt: Drawing of a Cyborg Smoke Grenade and a sign of a smoke cloud.
boxes.description: Used exclusively by Radicals. These grenades make up for their non-lethality with their tactical usage, concealing Radicals and their robotic allies as they close in.

boxes.title: Augmented Fist
boxes.alt: Drawing of a Cyborg Augmented Fist.
boxes.description: Like all Cyborgs, the Radical has their wrist and hands replaced with cybernetic counterparts. Such limbs allow them to land severe blows that can leave enemies sprawled on the floor, at the mercy of the Radical's other weapons.

boxes.title: Techno-Martial Arts
boxes.alt: Drawing of a Cyborg foot and a sign of a person doing a high kick.
boxes.description: The Radical swiftly delivers what its society calls "techno-martial arts", a highly agile and equally violent form of combat that takes advantage of their greatly superior strength. Most human foes stand little chance against such a flurry of metallic blows.

boxes.title: Heavy Fusion Repeater
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Heavy Fusion Repeater.
boxes.description: Also used by Automaton emplacements, the Heavy Fusion Repeater has exceptional stopping power, albeit at a considerably slower fire rate and poor cooling when compared to smaller Repeater-type weapons.

boxes.title: Heavy HE Rockets
boxes.alt: Drawing of two Automaton Heavy HE Rockets.
boxes.description: A general step up from the lighter ordinance used by smaller launchers. These heavy rockets are loaded with high-yield explosive warheads powerful enough to blow apart fortifications and destroy even armoured vehicles in a single hit.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Vehicle|Anti-Vehicle|notext}}
(Ballistic Damage Only)
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])

boxes.title: Warhead Detonation
boxes.alt: Drawing of an explosion with a black skull inside it.
boxes.description: While offensively devastating, the Heavy Rocket's payload is quite volatile. Even small arms fire is enough to detonate the warhead, destroying the walker entirely.

boxes.title: Weighty Stomp
boxes.alt: Drawing of an automaton foot.
boxes.description: The Heavy Strider's legs are designed with mobility and grip in mind. They can also be used to clear obstacles by flattening bushes, barbed wire, or bodies if the situation demands it.

boxes.title: Fusion Assault Cannon
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Fusion Assault Cannon.
boxes.description: The staple of the Devastator unit's arsenal. This twin-barrelled Fusion weapon fires in steady 2-round bursts with significant stopping power, though its overall accuracy leaves something to be desired.

boxes.title: HEAT Rocket Pod Array
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton HEAT Rocket Pod Array and 3 rockets.
boxes.description: Developed to be mounted upon the shoulders of a Devastator. The Rocket Pod Array can fire up to 12 devastating HEAT rockets that are capable of blasting infantry and light vehicles alike.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Vehicle|Anti-Vehicle|notext}}
(Ballistic Damage Only)
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])

boxes.title: Reinforced Steel Fist
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Reinforced Steel Fist.
boxes.description: While rarely close enough to engage in close quarters combat, Rocket Devastator units are more than capable of breaking open a Helldiver's helmet with their fist should the opportunity arise.

boxes.title: Stomp
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton foot.
boxes.description: On account of their weight, most Devastator-sized units can simply crush structures, flora, and foes alike underfoot, clearing paths for lighter units to cross unimpeded.

boxes.title: Portable Launcher (HEAT Rockets)
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Launcher and two HEAT Rockets.
boxes.description: The heaviest infantry weapon within the arsenal of the smallest Automatons. This anti-tank Portable Launcher is loaded with rocket-propelled HEAT Grenades that can break apart fortifications and vehicles alike.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Vehicle|Anti-Vehicle|notext}}
(Ballistic Damage Only)
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])

boxes.title: Steel Fist
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Steel Fist
boxes.description: While they are primarily equipped for long-range combat, the Rocket Raider is by no means helpless in hand-to-hand. Its steel gauntlet is more than strong enough to rip a man’s jaw clean off.

boxes.title: HE Grenade
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton HE Grenade and a sign of an explosion.
boxes.description: A throwable explosive similar to, but larger than, the [[G-12 High Explosive]] Grenade. Has a notably long fuse time that allows it to be quickly thrown back.

boxes.title: Hardened Ram
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: No less deadly than their unmutated counterparts, the Rupture-strain Charger is capable of smashing aside even reinforced colony walls with its shield-shaped head, as well as any remaining garrison forces unfortunate enough to be in its way.

boxes.title: Hardened Crush
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: Leveraging its heavier carapace plates lining its forelegs, the Rupture-strain Charger is more than capable of reducing human-sized targets messy pulps, with anything larger being reduced to scrap as it slams with the force of its immense weight upon target.

boxes.title: Thunderous Eruption
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: Whereas smaller Terminids of the Rupture-Strain merely emerge from the ground in order to ambush their foes, the Rupture-strain Charger bursts out with immense force, throwing about rubble, loose debris and people around like toys.

boxes.title: Corrosive Regurgitation
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: Whilst their tactics have changed, the Rupture-strain Spewer's stomach is still more than capable of purging deadly amounts of violently corrosive substances upon whatever draws its ire, even melting through vehicles.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Acid}}
(1.5x Damage to [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits]])
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])
3/s Acid DPS (4.0s)
(Via Direct Damage)

boxes.title: Bile Barrage
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: Taking advantage of their ability to burrow and emerge without warning at will, Rupture-strain Spewers have taken to spitting quick bursts of concentrated globules, which burst into showers of corrosive bile before the Spewer leaves as quickly as it arrived.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Acid}}
(1.5x Damage to [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits]])
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])
3/s Acid DPS (4.0s)
(Via Blast Damage

boxes.title: Bile Bombard
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: Rather unpleasantly, Caustic Spewers have evolved the muscles on their thorax structure to facilitate the launching of highly-concentrated "Bile Bombs" with great force and speed, allowing Caustic Spewers to act as primitive artillery.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Acid}}
(Melee Damage only)
(1.5x Damage to [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits]])
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])

boxes.title: Heavy Swing
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Steel Fist.
boxes.description: Spewer-strains can also rely on their enlarged forelegs to swing and slam would-be-attackers. While not their most devastating attack, they are still more than capable of crushing bone and tearing flesh with each blow.

boxes.title: Pressurised Rupture
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: The Rupture-strain of Spewers are no less vulnerable to violent self-detonations upon being punctured than their cousins, and its effects are no less deadly, leaving half-melted, foul smelling corpses in its wake.

boxes.title: Slashing Claws
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: Now hardened with additional dense chitin, the Rupture-strain of Warriors are capable of burrowing and digging at great speeds, beelining for their prey above before bursting out, implaing the surprised foe with sharp, heavy claws like a vicious animal.

boxes.title: Tearing Pincers
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: Living up to their name, the Scavenger's pincers are capable of pinning down and picking apart the remains of prey that had already been mauled by larger Terminids with alarming efficiency, easily stripping flesh from armour and bone alike.

boxes.title: Heavy Fusion Repeater
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Heavy Fusion Repeater.
boxes.description: Also used by Automaton emplacements, the Heavy Fusion Repeater has exceptional stopping power, albeit at a considerably slower fire rate and poor cooling when compared to smaller Repeater-type weapons.

boxes.title: Weighty Stomp
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton foot.
boxes.description: The Scout Strider's legs are designed with mobility and grip in mind. They can also be used to clear obstacles by flattening bushes, barbed wire, or bodies if the situation demands it.

boxes.title: Quad Heavy Fusion Cycler
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Quad Heavy Fusion Cycler.
boxes.description: The Quad Heavy Fusion Cycler is highly effective against ground targets. Living up to its name, the Shredder Heavy Tank can unleash blistering amounts of bolts against infantry, often reducing them to messy ribbons.

boxes.title: Ammunition Cookoff
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton tank with flaming holes and a drawing of an explosion with a black skull inside it.
boxes.description: Much like its heavier brethren, the Shredder Heavy Tank is quite vulnerable to Ammunition Cookoffs upon being knocked out, resulting in a devastating explosion in the surrounding area.

boxes.title: Dive Bomb
boxes.alt: Drawing of a shrieker's swipe
boxes.description: Taking to the skies, the Shriekers act akin to ancient harriers, swooping down towards their prey at great speed. They use their sharpened claws and wingtips to slice and slash their way through their target, at times even causing outright decapitation.

boxes.title: Mycotic Surge
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: Its stomach cavity now wholly producing vile hormonal spores, Bile Titans of the Spore Burst Strain are capable of regurgitating monumental amounts of concentrated spore clouds with such force that they can even knock down human-sized targets. These spores also enhance the speed of the Bile Titan's Terminid allies.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Acid}}
(1.5x Damage to [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits]])
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])

boxes.title: Cataclysmic Slam
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Steel Fist.
boxes.description: The Spore Burst Bile Titan is also capable of crushing whatever is before it with its multi-ton "pikes", impaling and skewering exos, cars and even tanks and outright obliterating anything smaller.

boxes.title: Death Throes
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: Upon death, Spore Burst Bile Titans will suddenly and violently explode with immense force, showering the area with its corrosive hormonal spores, harming those nearby and ensuring its foes will be weakened and its allies hastened even after dying.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Acid}}
(1.5x Damage to [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits]])
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])
3/s Acid DPS (4.0s)
(Via Blast Damage)

boxes.title: Serrated Slash
boxes.alt: Hunter Claw.
boxes.description: Despite its affliction with Gloom Spores, the Spore Hunter's mantis-like arms are no less deadly by any metric, slashing through armour like paper whilst its serrated edge leaves gaping wounds and shattered bones upon the hapless victim.

boxes.title: Leap
boxes.alt: Hunter Pounce
boxes.description: Still retaining the intelligence to outflank the foe, the Gloom afflicted Hunter is still capable of leaping great distances with said attacks being quick and violent, impaling and ripping apart the foe with tainted claws and teeth.

boxes.title: Diseased Lash
boxes.alt: Hunter Tongue
boxes.description: laced with a combination of potent venom and aggressively corrosive spores, the Spore-afflicted Hunter's tongue is capable of equally inflicting horrific lash injuries, said wounds slowly burnt away by the horrific concoction of venomous fluids seeping in.

boxes.title: Mycotic Detonation
boxes.alt: Drawing of a spore explosion.
boxes.description: Much like all Terminids completely overtaken with Gloom Spores, the Spore-strain Hunter is, when punctured or merely killed, capable of violently bursting, choking the air with orange and mildly corrosive spores that eat into flesh and armour alike.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Acid}}
(1.5x Damage to [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits]])
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])
3/s Acid DPS (4.0s)
(Via Blast Damage)

boxes.title: Tearing Pincers
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Portable Flamer.
boxes.description: Living up to their name, the Scavenger's pincers are capable of cutting down prey that had already been mauled by larger Terminids with alarming efficiency, easily stripping flesh from armour and bone alike.

boxes.title: Mycotic Burst
boxes.alt: What happens when a Meeg explodes.
boxes.description: Suffused with hormonal spores, the Spore Burst Strain Scavenger, when finally killed, will rupture violently, spraying copious spores with surprising force that can slowly eat away living tissue and armour, hastening allied Terminids in the process.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Acid}}
(1.5x Damage to [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits]])
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])
3/s Acid DPS (4.0s)
(Via Blast Damage)

boxes.title: Slashing Claws
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: The Warrior's chitin-hardened claws are more than capable of cleaving human-sized targets in half with but a few strikes. Even light vehicles, exosuits and buildings are not safe from its puncturing power.

boxes.title: Mycotic Detonation
boxes.alt: What happens when a Meeg explodes.
boxes.description: Larger than their Scavenger cousins, Spore Burst Warriors are filled with larger quantities of volatile hormonal spores, which are released upon death. The resulting detonation violently releases said spores that chew through metal and burn skin, as well as invigorating allied Terminids.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Acid}}
(1.5x Damage to [[Exosuit (disambiguation)|Exosuits]])
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])
3/s Acid DPS (4.0s)
(Via Blast Damage)

boxes.title: Impaling Strike
boxes.alt: Meeg.
boxes.description: Hyper-specialised in stalking and viciously dispatching prey. The Stalker's unique, mantis-like talons are capable of striking with blistering speed, sometimes even bifurcating human targets.

boxes.title: Barbed Laceration
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: Functioning akin to a spring-loaded harpoon. The barbed tongues of the Stalker impact with such force and speed that they knock human quarry to the ground, leaving them easy prey to their talons.

boxes.title: Plasma Destructor Gunpods
boxes.alt: A drawing of a Stingray cannon.
boxes.description: The Plasma Destructor is capable of unloading tens of Plasma Bolts every second, with each Bolt capable of blowing a molten hole the size of a human head into armoured vehicles and reducing anything lesser into burnt vapors.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Vehicle|Anti-Vehicle|notext}}
(Impact + Blast Damage)
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]] and [[TD-110|Maelstrom]])

boxes.title: Crash and Burn
boxes.alt: A drawing of a Stingray on fire.
boxes.description: A downed Stingray can still present itself as a significant danger as it comes plummeting back down to earth, crashing with such speed and force it can plow through buildings before finally disintegrating.

boxes.title: Explosive Demise
boxes.alt: A deadly explosion symbol.
boxes.description: The Stingray will signify its death with one final, cataclysmic explosion, engulfing anything and everything in superheated gas and molten shrapnel, leaving only smoldering remains.

boxes.title: Fusion SMG
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Fusion SMG.
boxes.description: An unergonomic and somewhat inaccurate firearm. The standard-issue small arm of most Troopers, Raiders and Marauders alike. Heat dissipation elements result in frequent overheating.

boxes.title: Steel Fist
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Trooper fist.
boxes.description: Often reserved for the foe who strays too close for comfort. A solid blow from a Trooper's steel-plated fist is more than capable of cracking plate, rupturing organs, and completely shattering bone with ease.

boxes.title: HE Grenade
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton HE Grenade and a sign of a explosion.
boxes.description: A throwable explosive similar to, but larger than, the [[G-12 High Explosive]] Grenade. Has a notably long fuse time that allows it to be quickly thrown back.

boxes.title: Clawed Swipe
boxes.alt: A drawing of the Veracitor's claw.
boxes.description: Once supposedly used in a more logistical role, the Veracitor's gigantic claws are just as capable of tearing apart foes that stand against them. Even light vehicles are not safe from its razor sharp talons.

boxes.title: Sundering Slam
boxes.alt: A drawing of a Veracitor's descending fist.
boxes.description: Alternatively, the Veracitor will settle with simply crushing its foe by slamming its fists upon them. The machine's strength is such that it often reduces any humanoid foe to a bloodied mess and can even flatten armoured vehicles into smoke-belching wrecks.

boxes.title: Shouldered Ram
boxes.alt: A drawing of a charging Veracitor.
boxes.description: The Veracitor may occasionally use its mass to plow through whatever obstacle or vehicle stands in its way. The few who survive will then have to contend with being crushed underfoot.

boxes.title:
Swipe and Claw
(All Variants)
boxes.alt: A drawing of a Voteless claw.
boxes.description: Once human hands, now corrupted and mutated beyond recognition and reformed into hardened claws, something the Voteless use to bludgeon, leap and tear their foe apart in mindless frenzy.

boxes.title: Plasma Macro-Culverin
boxes.alt: Hydrogen Macro-Culverin drawing
boxes.description: The primary armament of the mighty Vox Engine. These massive repeaters are capable of rapidly unloading explosive volleys of superheated plasma that are both capable of vaporising infantry, crumbling fortifications, and reducing vehicles into molten slag.
boxes.rof:
2s (Charge Time)
(235 RPM) (Per Gun)
1.3s (Direct Burst)
(6-Round Salvo)
2-4s (Sweep Salvo)
(12-30 Round Salvo)

boxes.title: Plasma Duster Miniguns
boxes.alt: Hydrogen Duster drawing
boxes.description: Mounted upon the Vox Engine's sides to engage those that flank it. These guns often leave little of the foes they engage beyond a fine red mist through their immense (and equally inaccurate) rate of fire.

boxes.title: Icarus Missile Launcher Pod
boxes.alt: Icarus Launcher Pod drawing
boxes.description: The Icarus Launcher Pod allows the Vox Engine to unload dozens of powerful, guided HEAT missiles, brutally decimating infantry and battering armoured vehicles into dented, blasted wrecks.
boxes.inflict status:
{{Status|Vehicle|Anti-Vehicle|notext}}
(Ballistic Damage Only)
(3.0x Damage To [[TD-220 Bastion MK XVI|Bastion]])
boxes.rof:
300 RPM (Salvo)
(16 Missiles per Salvo)
~40s (Pod Reload Time)

boxes.title: Critical Reactor Failure
boxes.alt: Vox Engine death explosion
boxes.description: Upon fatal damage being dealt to whatever reactor powers this war machine, the once mighty Vox Engine undergoes a chain of fierce explosions as its reactor melts down before finally erupting into a truly massive explosion that throws flaming debris about.

boxes.title: Plummeting Sarcophagus
boxes.alt: Plummeting Sarcophagi drawing
boxes.description: Chief amongst the debris thrown by said explosion is the now destroyed sarcophagus which, while functionless, still presents a danger as the heavy object plummets from the sky like a meteor, crushing any unfortunate who happens to be in its path.

boxes.title: Fusion Culverins
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Fusion Culverin.
boxes.description: A powerful weapon mounted onto the massive War Strider. Paired, these weapons have enough output to break apart armoured vehicles and completely obliterate anything smaller.

boxes.title: Weapon Failure (Fusion Culverin)
boxes.alt: Drawing of an explosion with a black skull inside it.
boxes.description: The Fusion Culverin is as incredibly powerful as it is worryingly fragile. Where damage to its frame can be enough to cause a misfire, violently bursting the barrel, releasing volatile energy and rendering the weapon completely unusable.

boxes.title: Grenade Projector Pod
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton Grenade Projector Pod and two grenades.
boxes.description: Loaded with HE Grenades similar to those thrown by Troopers, the Projector can unload said munitions at a massive rate, range and quantity. Firing in a parabolic arc, the Projector completely saturates an area with high explosive ordinance.

boxes.title: Superheavy Stomp
boxes.alt: Drawing of an Automaton foot.
boxes.description: Much like the smaller Hulks, the War Strider is capable of simply crushing whatever happens to be underneath it, albeit now with far more force, to the point where it can create shockwaves.

boxes.title: Slashing Claws
boxes.alt: Warrior Claw.
boxes.description: The Warrior's chitin-hardened claws are more than capable of cleaving human-sized targets in half with but a few strikes. Even light vehicles, exosuits and buildings are not safe from its puncturing power.

boxes.title: Tesla Suppressor
boxes.alt: An image of a Watcher eye with an electric symbol.
boxes.description: This device is capable of building up a charge and releasing it as an arc, inflicting painful electrical burns and disorienting the foe in the process.

boxes.title: Crashing Weight
boxes.alt: A deadly explosion symbol.
boxes.description: A plummeting Watcher remains a hazard to any underneath it. Its weight is such that it is capable of crushing any unfortunate that happens to be below it.

boxes.title: Detonation
boxes.alt: A deadly explosion symbol.
boxes.description: It is unknown if it is by design to prevent capture or because it is simply fragile, but Watchers violently explode upon crashing onto solid ground, killing infantry and even capable of severely damaging vehicles.

boxes.title: Blade Protrusion
boxes.alt: A drawing of a Fleshmob appendage.
boxes.description: Taking the form of 2 additional limbs sprouting from what was once its shoulders, each ending in a metallic spike, The Wretch has little trouble impaling, dismembering and overall butchering whatever victms happen to be in its way.

boxes.title: Swiping Hands
boxes.alt: A drawing of a fleshmob charging.
boxes.description: Whilst nowhere even remotely as potent as their upper scythe-tipped limbs, the Wretch is still capable of swiping at foes with what was once its original arms, which are still more than capable of wounding and disorienting foes with quick swipes.
